name: hEvo two-stage haplotype pretraining and paired-allele LLR scoring
description: Two-stage training procedure: Stage I span-masked representation learning on deduplicated haplotype windows, then Stage II calibration of the nucleotide prediction head on variant-centred contexts. Variants are scored as LLR = log P(ALT|context) minus log P(REF|context). A positive LLR means a higher conditional likelihood for ALT.
